ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a cycle diagram of a flowering plant. The plant is in the middle, and there is a sun in the upper left and rays of light shining toward the plant. Label F is located on the left side of the figure, right next to the position of the sunlight rays. Reasoning: The question asks which stage in the cycle F represents. Because F is marked at the position where sunlight shines onto the plant, this visual element represents sunlight or light energy entering the plant process. Therefore, F represents light energy.
